# Zebriyo

Zebriyo is an affordable website maker for CA websites, CS websites, startup websites, hotel websites, NGO websites, school websites, college websites, clinic websites, Instagram websites, influencer websites, and portfolio websites. It also designs animated, best-looking websites.

## Facts

- Brand: Zebriyo
- Tagline: Go Beyond. Grow Bigger.
- Offer: websites for CAs, company secretaries, startups, hotels, NGOs, schools, colleges, clinics, creators, and small businesses
- Look: animated websites, coolest-website searches, best looking websites — motion where it helps
- First step: a working preview of the main page within 24 hours of sending details
- The 24-hour step is a preview, not the finished website
- Monthly care starts at INR 1,999
- New Basic website starts at INR 9,999 one-time
- Upscale: INR 14,999 one-time
- Premium: INR 24,999 one-time
- Growth Care: INR 2,799 / month
- Business Plus: INR 4,999 / month
- No required calls; changes by email or WhatsApp
- Sample layouts on the site are placeholders, not client projects or results
- Hotel and clinic samples exist on /work
- Currency: INR
- Area served: India and remote

## Who it is for

- CA / chartered accountant websites
- CS / company secretary websites
- Startup websites
- Hotel websites
- NGO website makers
- School websites
- College websites
- Clinic websites
- Instagram and influencer websites
- Portfolio makers
- People searching for the best animated website, coolest website, or best looking websites

Send details at /start. Explore sample websites at /work. Sector list at /#sectors.
